thread.title: Wall Street Mixed Into Close as Measures Pare Losses Before Apple, Fed

author: MT Newswires
title: Wall Street Mixed Into Close as Measures Pare Losses Before Apple, Fed
text:
Shutterstock photo Wall Street was mixed on Tuesday, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average weaker for a third straight day while the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Composite reclaimed losses and turned positive as information technology headed higher ahead of key earnings from Apple ( AAPL ).
The group gained 1.1% into the close as one of just two sectors on the S&P that were in the green. A slide in crude prices dented the energy component while telecoms and consumer names also retreated. Financials were slightly down as the Federal Open Market Committee's third interest-rate meeting of 2018 got underway.
